description:
BOOM!, an imprint of Random House Worlds, seeks an experienced Editor to join the team. Founded in 2005, BOOM! is the home to award-winning, critically acclaimed, bestselling comic books & graphic novels, including Keanu Reeves’ BRZRKR , Something is Killing the Children , Lumberjanes , Slaughterhouse-Five: The Graphic Novel , Hellraiser , Mighty Morphin Power Rangers , and Mexican Gothic: The Graphic Novel . A BOOM! Editor takes responsibility and ownership of the creative process, creative execution, and level of commercial and critical success of the projects under their purview. They work independently to produce high quality creative content on time while maintaining strong creative relationships with talent and key partners. This role involves acquiring new projects, creative development on new and existing projects and properties, extensive independent project management from creating and managing schedules to overseeing art and design, and demonstrating creative excellence with emphases on core audiences and visual storytelling. An affinity for highly communicative collaboration; creative development; wide-ranging problem-solving; and a general, top-level knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite terms are essential.

Must be able to handle the details of immediately urgent tasks, while also remembering to step back, consider the big picture, and adjust strategy when needed.
Specific responsibilities include:

• Acquire new projects, develop and produce new and existing projects, and contribute to the overall commercial creative execution of the BOOM! Studios List

• Be the project manager and primary point of contact for overall scheduling, communication, administration, and creative development and production for all titles under purview

• Provide support within Executive Editor’s office, including scheduling, talent relations, and internal tracking and routing

• Collaborate on and create go-to-market strategies, run development meetings, and identify key opportunities for sales-marketing

title: Technical Product Owner | Integrations (m/f/d)
description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.
Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day .
We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.
We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.
We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.
In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.
We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

title: PIP Claims Handler
description:
This is a remote position.
Position Summary:
We are seeking an experienced PIP Claims Handler to manage and investigate Personal Injury Protection (PIP) claims related to automotive accidents. This role is heavily focused on reviewing claims for accuracy, identifying inconsistencies, mitigating fraud exposure, and controlling claim costs while ensuring compliance with state regulations and policy requirements.
The ideal candidate has extensive experience handling PIP claims within the auto insurance, legal, healthcare billing, or claims administration space and is highly skilled at scrutinizing medical documentation, billing practices, and treatment timelines.
This position requires strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and confidence in challenging questionable claims, excessive billing, or unsupported treatment.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities (include, but are not limited to the following):
Key Responsibilities

• This role primarily handles PIP claims arising in Maryland, with regular exposure to Pennsylvania, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Virginia, and the District of Columbia. Familiarity with the regulatory frameworks in any of these states is strongly preferred; mastery of Maryland PIP is required

• Review, investigate, and manage PIP claims from initial notice through resolution

• Analyze medical records, treatment plans, billing submissions, police reports, and supporting documentation

• Identify billing irregularities, excessive treatment patterns, duplicate charges, inflated claims, or potential fraud indicators

• Evaluate claim validity and determine exposure based on applicable state PIP regulations and policy guidelines

• Defend against inaccurate, unsupported, or excessive claims through detailed file review and documentation

• Coordinate with attorneys, medical providers, adjusters, third-party administrators, and internal stakeholders

• Negotiate settlements and reductions with providers, attorneys, and claimants when appropriate

• Monitor claim timelines and ensure all statutory deadlines and compliance requirements are met

• Prepare detailed claim notes, summaries, and recommendations for leadership or legal review

• Assist with litigation support and respond to disputes, arbitrations, or audits related to PIP claims

• Identify trends and recommend process improvements to reduce claim leakage and financial exposure

• Maintain accurate claim files and documentation within internal systems

Qualifications Required:

• 3+ years of direct experience handling automotive PIP claims

• Strong knowledge of PIP regulations, medical billing review, and claims investigation practices

• Experience defending against questionable or inflated PIP claims

• Ability to interpret medical records, treatment documentation, and billing codes

• Experience in identifying fraud indicators, provider abuse, or claim inconsistencies

• Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to manage a high-volume caseload while maintaining accuracy

• Proficient in claims management systems and Microsoft Office / Google Workspace

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in rideshare, fleet, rental, or commercial auto claims environments

• Prior experience working with SIU (Special Investigations Unit) teams

• Familiarity with state-specific PIP regulations, especially high-volume PIP states

• Experience working with attorneys and litigation management

• Insurance adjuster license(s) where applicable

Salary: $65,000 - $70,000 per year; depending on experience
Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, skeptical in the right ways, and comfortable challenging unsupported claims or questionable documentation. They should be able to balance thorough investigation with efficient claim handling and understand how to reduce unnecessary claim spend without compromising compliance or professionalism.

title: Head of Pricing & Monetization (m/f/d)
description:
About Babbel Labs

Babbel Labs is building the future of language learning. We're an AI-first, independent company within the Babbel group, based in Berlin. Our teams bring AI, R&D and product together to ship experiences that set a new standard for how people learn.

Your Learning Journey in This Role

We are looking for a Head of Pricing & Monetization to define and evolve Babbel’s pricing, packaging and monetization strategy. You will lead pricing decisions across existing and new products, including subscription plans, family plans, add-ons, trials and offers.

How You’ll Make an Impact

- Own Babbel’s pricing and monetization strategy across products, markets and customer segments, and develop the frameworks and processes behind it.

- Design pricing and packaging for new products and models, including subscription options, family plans and add-ons.

- Lead pricing decisions for existing plans, free trials, offers and customer segments, from analysis and modelling through to cross-functional alignment and launch.

- Establish clear principles for discounts, promotions and offers across Marketing and CRM, and improve pricing pages, checkout and subscription flows.

- Measure the impact of pricing decisions on revenue, conversion, retention and acquisition costs, using experimentation and analysis to continuously improve performance.

 

Your Skills and Qualifications

We think you’ll need the following experience to succeed in the role:

- Senior-level experience owning pricing or monetization in a fast-growing technology, subscription, digital product or consumer business.

- A proven track record of leading significant pricing or packaging changes end to end, from customer and market insight through to modelling, stakeholder alignment, launch and post-launch measurement.

- Experience building or scaling pricing capabilities, frameworks or ways of working, and partnering with Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, Finance and Data teams.

In addition, here are the skills and capabilities we’re looking for:

- Commercial and strategic judgement: Understands how pricing and packaging affect revenue, conversion, retention, customer acquisition and long-term customer value, and can make sound trade-offs.

- Quantitative and technical fluency: Comfortable with pricing methods such as elasticity analysis, willingness-to-pay research, segmentation, forecasting and experiment analysis. Able to build models, work with data and use code where appropriate.

- Product execution and experimentation: Translates pricing strategy into clear product requirements, experiments and launches. Uses AI tools and coding agents to prototype, test and iterate efficiently.

- Communication, influence and ownership: Explains complex analysis clearly to both technical and executive audiences, persuades senior stakeholders, creates clarity in ambiguous situations and drives decisions through to completion.

WAYS OF WORKING

You will work across Product, Growth, Marketing, Finance, Data and Engineering, building alignment around pricing decisions and helping teams move from analysis to action.

The role requires strong analytical depth, commercial judgement and hands-on execution. You should be comfortable working independently, challenging assumptions constructively and taking ownership without a large team around you.

Babbel’s operating language is English, so professional fluency in written and spoken English is required.

Please note that our company’s operating language is English, so you will need to be able to work in English.

Why Join Babbel Labs

- Work on a mission-driven product with global impact.

- Shape how AI is used responsibly in education.

title: Senior Customer Support Service Delivery Program Manager

description:
In 1931, electrical draftsman Harry Beck looked at London’s Underground map and saw a system that had become too complicated to understand.

The maps at the time tried to represent the city geographically. Beck realized that wasn’t what riders actually needed. What mattered was how the system connected: which lines went where, where you could transfer, and the simplest way to get from one place to another. So he redrew the network around those relationships instead. His design became the foundation for the modern Tube map and changed how people navigated London.

Mercury’s Customer Experience organization has its own increasingly complex network.

As Mercury grows, the right place for support work will keep changing. Some new or complex work may benefit from starting in an incubation team before we know how it should scale. From there, it might move into Core Support, remain specialized, transition to an outsourced partner, or become increasingly supported by AI-powered tooling. The challenge is knowing where work belongs at each stage of its lifecycle, when it’s ready to move, and how to make those transitions without compromising the customer experience.

For the first 9-12 months, a significant majority of your work will focus on our growing BPO partnership. You’ll identify opportunities to expand the work we deliver through that partnership, build the operational and financial case for doing so, align CX leadership around those recommendations, and lead approved transitions from initial scoping through stabilization.

Over time, the scope will broaden. You’ll apply the same thinking across our wider service delivery ecosystem, helping us evaluate when work should enter an incubation model, when it is ready to graduate, and whether its next home should be Core Support, a specialized team, an outsourced partner, AI-powered tooling, or another model as our capabilities evolve.

You won’t be the sole decision-maker on where work lives. Your role is to develop the recommendation: bring together the data, customer impact, operational realities, and tradeoffs; build a compelling case; and help CX leadership reach a well-informed decision. Once a direction is approved, you’ll own the program that turns it into reality.

This is a role for someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution. You should be equally energized by building a strong argument for how our service delivery model should evolve and by working through the operational details required to make that change succeed.

In this role, you will:

• Lead high-impact programs that evolve how CX delivers support, with the first 9-12 months heavily focused on expanding and optimizing our BPO partnership.

• Identify opportunities to move work to a different service delivery model and build the case for change using customer, operational, and financial data. This could include recommending that emerging or complex work move into incubation, as well as determining when incubated work is mature enough to transition into Core Support, a specialized team, or our BPO partnership.

• Help define what makes work ready to move. Develop clear criteria for when a workflow needs incubation, when it has reached sufficient maturity and stability to graduate, and which delivery model is best positioned to own it next.

• Evaluate where AI-powered tooling could take on, augment, or reshape support work, and partner with the right teams to build a clear case for when automation creates a better customer and business outcome.

• Lead approved service delivery transitions end to end, whether work is moving into incubation, graduating from incubation, transitioning between internal teams, or moving to an outsourced partner. Own the program from initial scoping and business case through readiness, migration, ramp, stabilization, and handoff into long-term operations.

• Partner across Workforce Management, Enablement, QA, Support, and other teams to build transition plans that account

title: BSA/AML Officer - US
description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the backbone to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

THE JOB

You find risk, measure it and call it. You do not fix it.

Every finding you write answers three things: what is broken, how bad it is, and what evidence proves it. You don't soften the rating and you don't propose the remedy. The business owns the fix. You own the truth about the risk.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Test our BSA/AML, KYC, OFAC and transaction monitoring controls end to end, independently of the teams that run them

- Rate every finding (high / medium / low) with evidence that holds up in front of a regulator

- Pull and analyze data yourself; you don't wait for someone to send you a report

- Challenge thresholds, alert logic and sampling assumptions with numbers, not opinions

- Track open issues until owners close them, and escalate when they don't

- Prepare us for regulator exams and audits, and be the person in the room who already knows the weak spots

WHAT YOU NEED (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- 4+ years in BSA/AML, FinCrime, internal audit or regulatory compliance

- Experience at a top-tier audit/advisory firm, in-house compliance, or both. Both is ideal.

- You have written findings that a regulator, auditor or board actually read

- You can say "this is high risk" to a senior leader and point to the regulation which proves it.

- Deep working knowledge of the BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, OFAC and FinCEN expectations

NICE TO HAVE

- Law degree (JD) or bar admission

- Degree in engineering, mathematics, statistics or another STEM field

- SQL: you can query transaction data yourself

- Python or R for analysis, sampling or testing alert logic

- Statistics: sampling design, hypothesis testing, threshold and model validation

- CAMS, CRCM, CIA, CISA, CPA or CFE

- Exposure to AI or model risk (SR 11-7, NIST AI RMF)

YOU WILL NOT ENJOY THIS ROLE IF

- You need someone else to pull the data for you

- You round risk ratings down to keep people comfortable

- You are uncomfortable being the person no one wants in the meeting

- You uniform to the norm.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Data Curation & Dataset Strategy
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our datasets Team

Wayve's datasets team own the driving data that our AI Driver learns from, covering ingestion, annotation, retrieval and data quality. As our data grows from hundreds of petabytes towards exabyte scale, deciding what we keep, and where, is one of the biggest levers on both model quality and cost. This role sits at the centre of that challenge, shaping the data that model engineers train on across the company.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Build and own the ingestion-time model that scores incoming driving data and routes it to hot, cold, archive or delete

- Work with training teams to define the right data distributions for every model we're building

- Deliver early storage-cost savings through practical heuristics, then develop ML-driven filtering

- Partner with ingestion, annotation, retrieval, data quality, model training, AV/robotics, evaluation and storage teams to set company-wide data policy

- Lead and work hands-on with a small group of software and ML engineers to build data provisioning and data provenance features into Corpus

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Defining our dataset content strategy: which data and metadata we need, and why, so training teams can select the most valuable data as smoothly as possible

- Steering data selection by what our model engineers need right now. For example, if we're weak at unprotected right turns at traffic lights, those scenarios go straight to hot storage

- Delivering large, measurable storage-cost savings as ingestion scales across our internal fleet and partner and OEM data

- Evolving from practical heuristics to ML-driven filtering, and influencing what gets filtered at the vehicle and edge

- Working as a pair with our Corpus Implementation Engineer to turn strategy into production systems

 

🙌 You should apply if

- You have strong autonomous-vehicle or robotics experience, working with large-scale driving, sensor or comparable data

- You're a principal, hands-on ML engineer who has built models that score, select or filter data

- You've operated at petabyte scale and are comfortable with the engineering that comes with it

- You're strong in Python and Spark, with large-scale cloud data experience

- You have strong quantitative intuition and use it to make practical, measurable decisions

- You're pragmatic and high-ownership, and can set direction across several teams without direct authority

- You bring experience in data selection, retention or filtering for model training, edge or vehicle-side filtering, computer vision or high-volume IoT data, or leading small cross-functional groups (any of these is a bonus)

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

About CoLab
At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.
Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.
What is Sales Engineering at CoLab?
Sales Engineering at CoLab is a team of mechanical engineers who sit at the intersection of product, sales, and customer success. They act as product experts, industry experts, and the voice of the customer-playing a critical role in helping prospects and customers realize the full value of CoLab.
The team operates across three core functions:

•
Sales Engineers (SEs): Focus on the pre-sales experience, partnering with prospective customers to evaluate CoLab and understand how it fits into their workflows and engineering challenges.

•
Customer Solutions Engineers (CSEs): Work with existing customers to drive complex deployments and transform how teams collaborate. They help organizations adopt new ways of working enabled by CoLab to achieve ambitious outcomes.

•
Mechanical Forward Deployed Engineers (MFDEs): Partner closely with specific customers to design and build tailored solutions for unique or high-impact problems, working alongside dedicated software engineering resources at CoLab.

While this role is focused on the pre-sales Solutions Engineer function, the strongest candidates bring a skill set that can flex across all three areas. Sales Engineers at CoLab are not siloed-they are adaptable, customer-centric, and capable of contributing wherever they can drive the most impact. As the team grows, we will be exploring how CSE’s and SE’s could become more of a single role.
All three functions regularly:

• Prepare and deliver engaging, specific demos that showcase how CoLab addresses customer pain points and delivers unique value.

• Partner with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to solve challenging customer problems across diverse mechanical design and engineering use cases.

• Understand a customer’s current-state workflows, pain points, and how they map to business outcomes.

• Map how customers work today to CoLabs capabilities, and challenge them on new ways of working with what CoLab unlocks.

• Be a trusted advisor to customers and prospects, on what is possible with AI in the context of mechanical engineering today, and in the future.

• Partner with Product Managers on new product initiatives to incorporate the perspective of a mechanical engineer in what we’re building.

• Share customer insights with Product to ensure we’re always building what our customers need.

• Act as an instructor to cross functional teams at CoLab for engineering topics. Example: “What is Injection Molding, what is DFM in this context.”

• Work with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to improve go-to-market strategy and enhance the customer experience.

What you specialize in as a pre-sales SE.
CoLab is a category-creating product, which means you’re not just showing a tool, you’re helping people understand a new way of working. As a pre-sales Sales Engineer, you specialize in guiding everyone from end users to executives in seeing what’s possible and why it matters for how they work today.

You will combine deep systems understanding in data center power and cooling systems to aid in SOO, design, maintenance & operability, troubleshooting and other engineering related responsibility around key equipment. Remote - travel 50%

- Translate field learning into design feedback, preventive maintenance improvements, training, and reusable standards.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- 8+ years of hands-on experience supporting critical electrical, mechanical, or electromechanical infrastructure in data centers, industrial facilities, utilities, manufacturing, or similarly complex environments.

- Deep technical expertise in at least one discipline, electrical or mechanical, with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot across electromechanical and controls boundaries.

- Experience building, leading, or materially developing a field engineering, service, maintenance, or technician team.

- Demonstrated success leading high-severity troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and reliability improvement.

- Ability to read and use one-line diagrams, schematics, P&IDs, sequence-of-operations documents, control diagrams, equipment manuals, and commissioning records.

- Strong safety judgment and experience working under formal energization, isolation, maintenance, and change-control procedures.

- Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, technicians, vendors, construction teams, and senior stakeholders.

- Ability to travel up to 50% and support planned or urgent field activity when required.

title: Senior Incident Responder
description:
BlackCloak ’s mission is to protect corporate executives and high-profile individuals in their personal lives, mitigating risks to their families, companies, reputation, and finances. We defend our clients’ digital lives from hackers, privacy leaks, and identity theft. If you are passionate about helping to protect others, then keep reading - this may be your next great opportunity.

BlackCloak is seeking a seasoned and highly skilled Senior Incident Responder to join our Technical Success Team. This is a senior, client-facing individual contributor role for someone who has spent years on both sides of the problem: the technical compromise of computers, phones, and online accounts, and the financial fraud that so often follows it. In this critical role, you will serve as the primary escalation point and lead investigator for complex security events; taking ownership of the full incident response lifecycle, from initial triage and containment through eradication, recovery, and post-incident reporting.

Our clients are executives, board members, and high-profile individuals whose personal accounts and devices are targeted precisely because their corporate ones are hard to breach. When something goes wrong in a client's personal digital life, you are the person who takes the call, works the incident end to end, and stays with them until it is resolved. You will also help us get better at preventing the next one: mapping how each incident unfolded against both the cyber attack kill chain and the personal attack kill chain, closing the gaps that made it possible, and mentoring the responders behind you.

If you excel at guiding clients through high-stress situations, possess deep technical expertise in digital forensics, and have a proven track record of handling sophisticated threats targeting high-profile individuals, this is an opportunity to elevate your career and make a tangible impact.

What You Will Do

• Execute End-to-End Incident Response: Lead comprehensive incident handling consistent with core IR principles (NIST/SANS) from the initial client request and triage through containment, recovery, and post-incident lessons learned.

• Investigate Complex Compromises & Targeted Attacks: Manage and remediate severe client security incidents, including but not limited to, compromised email ecosystems, SIM swap attacks, financial account takeovers, and targeted credential harvesting.

• Device Analysis: Conduct analysis on client computers and mobile devices to assess the scope of compromise and implement effective remediation strategies.

• Remediate Fraud & Identity Theft: Analyze and assess account activity and transaction records available to the client on their email, banking, retail, and social platforms to help establish what occurred, and support clients in their conversations with the platforms on fraud investigations, disputes, account freezes, etc.. Guide identity theft victims through the remediation process - credit bureau freezes and fraud alerts, IdentityTheft.gov and law enforcement reporting - and advise clients on the activity they should watch for and report back to the team.

• Map the Attack Chain: Map observed activity against the personal attack kill chain - from data-broker reconnaissance and social engineering of the client's inner circle through device compromise, account takeover, and financial monetization - to identify the likely stage of an attack and the actions that break the chain, focusing on technique and exposure rather than actor attribution.

• Provide White-Glove Client Support: Interface directly with clients and, where authorized, their families and support staff - assistants, family office, corporate security - during high-stakes emergency onboardings and active incidents, providing calm, clear, and authoritative guidance while communicating complex threat assessments.

• Participate in On-Call Rotation: Serve in an on-call and escalation rotation that requires occasional nights and wee

title: Director, Software Engineering
description:
About Feanix Bio

Feanix is rebuilding animal breeding from the genome up.

We’re a YC-backed startup using whole-genome sequencing and custom ML models to help dairy farmers make better breeding and herd management decisions. Our technology is genuinely novel: we can sequence a full genome from a single hair at a fraction of traditional industry costs, our models achieve ~90% prediction accuracy on traits where existing approaches sit closer to ~30%, and we’re pioneering farm-specific genomic predictions that turn genetics into practical, actionable decisions.

That technology is translating into real adoption. In a short time, we’ve grown to serve roughly 1% of the U.S. dairy industry, with many customers in the pipeline. We started with dairy because our founders grew up on dairy farms and understand firsthand the problems we’re solving. But genetics is foundational to every agricultural industry, and dairy is only the beginning.

We’re building Feanix with a small, high-caliber team where people have meaningful ownership and work end to end. There are no unnecessary layers and very little room for busywork - just difficult problems at the intersection of biology, data, and software that haven’t been solved before.

If you’re exceptional at what you do and want your work to have a measurable impact on an entire industry, we’d love to build it with you.

About The Role
Feanix is expanding its product offerings based on our farmers' needs and moving into other species, and engineering has to scale with these business goals. Today we're a small, tight engineering team behind one core product: Autopilot and sire mating, the decision engine farmers act on every day. We're shifting from individuals carrying whole systems to teams that share them, and we're growing in close partnership with our product organization. Over the next 12-18 months we plan to grow engineering to around 30 people. The technology organization includes software, hardware, and product, and this role leads software development.
You'll be our first Director of Engineering, reporting to the CTO. You'll lead a team of engineering managers: two have already joined, and you'll hire more to support the organization's growth. Our staff and principal engineers, who lead architecture, also report directly to you rather than to the EMs. You run the engineering org and its delivery, and you set technical direction together with them.
You'll report to a repeat CTO who wants thought partners: people who lay out the options, show their reasoning, and ask what we'd do if the current options disappeared. You'll also be one of a small group of technical leaders setting direction for the company. We're growing fast and working with biological systems, so designing with an experimental mindset is crucial.. title: Bid & Quality Manager
description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance. That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users.

We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken - you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you’ll be doing

As our Bid & Quality Manager, you’ll be the person who takes Satispay through every client tender and keeps our quality system running. This role involves managing tenders and supplier qualifications, as well as looking after our Quality Management System. You’ll work every day with Sales, Legal, Product and the heads of each department, and you’ll be the one who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks, from a tender deadline to an expiring certificate.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

- Supplier qualifications - Keep Satispay registered and up to date on our clients’ supplier portals, and work with Sales to collect and validate the documents each client asks for. Renew company documents and certifications (DURC, DURF, company registry extracts, ISO/ESG certifications) before they expire, and improve our scores with clients (IT and ESG questionnaires).

- Tender analysis - Run a first feasibility check on every tender and write a short summary so management can decide whether to take part (Go/No-Go). Then read the tender documents in depth and send clarification requests when something isn’t clear.

- Tender offers - Lead the working group, manage milestones and deadlines, and prepare the administrative documents, technical offer and economic offer. Upload everything through the required channel (PEC, email or portal) and handle follow-up requests and economic analyses before the award.

- Pipeline and learnings - Keep the tender pipeline and the response calendar up to date, and look back at the tenders we won and lost to learn what to do better.

- Clients and contracts - Join client meetings to collect information (tenders or negotiations) and be the contact point for Legal on contract negotiation and review.

- Quality system - Keep our Quality Management System policies and procedures up to date, and guide the heads of each department so their processes are properly documented. Maintain the risk register, the list of critical suppliers and the KPI matrix linked to our quality objectives.

- KPIs and process performance - Collect data from process owners, track KPIs every quarter and go back to the owners when a KPI falls below its threshold.

- Audits and reporting - Plan the audit schedule and be the contact for external auditors. Turn quality data, audit findings and process insights into management reviews and a quarterly report on risks, suppliers and KPIs.

Who we’re looking for

We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you’re curious and ready for real ownership, you’ll fit in!

- Private tender portals - You know how to use, update and upload documents on clients’ private supplier portals (such as Jaggaer or SAP).

- Clear writing - You can write administrative documents, policies and procedures with a critical eye, and adapt ready-made templates to what each client asks for.

- Quality systems - You have experience with Quality Management Systems (such as ISO 9001 or equivalent), ideally in a service or financial services context. Audit experience is a plus.

- Analytical mindset - You’re comfortable with KPIs and metrics, and with tools like Looker or similar. You’re also curious about AI and happy to use

We are looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to support the development, deployment, security, and ongoing operations of an enterprise case management application platform built on OutSystems.

description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Startups team at Airwallex partners with the most promising venture-backed companies across Asia to provide seamless access to our global financial infrastructure - empowering them to scale without borders. We sit at the intersection of fintech product, venture capital networks, and founder communities, taking a hands-on, consultative approach to helping startups professionalise their cross-border financial operations from their earliest institutional funding round through to growth stage and beyond.

Our motion is equal parts commercial and ecosystem. We build deep relationships with top-tier VCs, co-host events with accelerators and ecosystem partners, and embed ourselves in the startup communities across Singapore and the broader region. We are a tight, high-conviction team seeking to seed and grow lasting relationships with the companies that will define the next decade of innovation in Asia.

 

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT - AI SOLUTIONS

This is not a standard payments sales role. Airwallex has built AgentOS - a production-grade toolkit that lets AI agents work directly with a company's Airwallex account, so founders and finance teams can run cross-border finance operations in plain English instead of clicking through a dashboard. We're one of the first cross-border platforms in the world to ship this, and Singapore is one of the first markets where we're taking it to founders.

As the AI Solutions AE for Singapore startups, you'll be on the front line of that motion. You won't just sell accounts and FX - you'll help AI-native and AI-curious founders reimagine how their finance function runs: multi-currency cash visibility, supplier onboarding, corporate cards and spend, and billing, increasingly driven by agentic workflows. You'll be expected to become genuinely fluent in our AI finance story, translate an early and fast-moving capability into concrete value for each company, and help us build some of our first AgentOS customer stories. Comfort with ambiguity and a real interest in where AI is taking finance are essential - this is beta-stage, frontier work.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As an Account Executive on the Startups team, you will own the full sales cycle - from sourcing and prospecting through to close, onboarding, and ongoing account growth. You will work closely with venture capital partners, ecosystem organisations, and founders directly to build pipeline, convert high-value startup customers, and grow their usage of the Airwallex platform - including our AI finance and AgentOS capabilities - over time.

This is a role for someone passionate about the startup world, energised by founder conversations, excited by AI, and looking to be known in the ecosystem as a trusted partner who helps startups get their financial plumbing right and points them toward what's next.

FULL-CYCLE SALES & CONSULTATIVE SELLING

title: Applied Scientist, Engineering

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Discovery team at Anthropic is organized around the north star goal of building an AI scientist - a system capable of solving the long-term reasoning challenges and basic capabilities necessary to push the scientific and technological frontier.

We're expanding our work on engineering and the applied sciences. Our goal is to contribute to training Claude to invent, design, and engineer across every discipline and scale, reliably and safely: new manufacturing and experimental techniques, processes, materials, devices, instruments, machines, energy systems, and factories. We want this work to accelerate science and technology and benefit people widely.

We're seeking exceptional researchers with deep expertise in one or more of these areas. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of frontier AI and your field, developing rigorous methods to measure and improve Claude's performance on complex engineering and scientific tasks. You'll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and partners across Anthropic and industry to build AI systems that can engage in all phases of research and development, and to test Claude's designs against real-world feedback.

Key responsibilities

• Translate between engineering domain knowledge and machine learning objectives

Minimum qualifications

• Deep expertise and hands-on R&D or industry experience in an engineering or applied science discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, materials, chemical, aerospace, structural, industrial, or manufacturing engineering; applied physics; computational simulation

• Experience with AI or machine learning, whether evaluating and training AI systems or applying these tools in your field

• Track record of taking work from concept through to a working result, such as a product, process, device, experiment, or tool

• Hands-on proficiency with the computational design, analysis, or simulation tools used in your field

• Basic programming proficiency, for example in Python

• Ability to navigate ambiguity and develop solutions in a rapidly evolving research environment

• Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, and to explain your field clearly to people outside it

• Commitment to using AI to accelerate engineering and scientific progress while maintaining high ethical standards

Preferred qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on R&D or industry experience in an engineering or applied science discipline

• Ph.D. in an engineering or applied science field, or equivalent industry experience

• Industry experience in product design and manufacturing, or in developing engineering or scientific simulation software

title: Engineering Leader
description:
The Role

As Consumer Engineering Leader, you’ll be the engineering counterpart to our Consumer Product Leader. Together you’ll own a simple question: How can we extend our product suite to be integrated deeper with our customers’ financial lives?

Engineering leadership at Taptap Send is hands on. You’ll be building POCs while managing/coaching a team of super passionate, high caliber engineers. We are looking for someone who finds themselves on the cusp of product and engineering and is excited to shape the next generation of products at a company with millions of customers. The mandate is to move fast and autonomously, understand our customers, build new products they love, and become the financial home for the immigrant communities we serve.

Key Responsibilities

- Own the Outcomes: Partner with Product to set and hit targets on adoption, retention, and how well our products serve the range of a customer’s financial life. You’re accountable for how well these products work, not just for shipping them.

- Run the Experiment Loop: Take ideas from hypothesis to live test in weeks, not quarters. Build POCs yourself. Instrument everything. Read the data honestly and recommend, kill, or scale.

- Spot the Opportunities: Bring your own ideas. You should be looking at our customers, our data, and the market and arriving with a point of view on the next unmet need worth solving.

- Ship the Winners: When a bet proves out, lead the work to harden it and get it into the core app at production quality with reliability, security, and compliance standards intact.

- Stay Hands-On: Contribute code. You set the technical direction for consumer product engineering and you’re in it with the team.

- Build and Lead a Small, High-Leverage Team: Hire, coach, and retain product-minded engineers who thrive on ambiguity and speed.

- Work Across the Company: Partner with teams across the business to get experiments live and learnings shared, building on our existing systems and creating new ones that other teams can plug into.

What We’re Looking For

- Product-Minded Engineers: Your background is building user-facing products and the services behind it. You’re comfortable owning a feature end-to-end, from backend through to what the user touches.

- Track Record of Rapid Experimentation: You can point to things you built in weeks that tested a real hypothesis, and to things you killed. Candidates whose experience is entirely long-horizon builds won’t be a fit.

- 0 to 1 Experience: You’ve done your best work at Series B-E companies or standing up new products/businesses within a larger company. You know what it’s like to build with real constraints and real growth pressure.

- Comfort with Compliance: You’ve shipped in regulated environments and treat compliance as a design constraint to build around from day one, not a hurdle at the end.

- Commercially Grounded: You reach for the business case before the architecture diagram. You can judge whether an idea is worth the company’s time, and you hold a high engineering bar while doing it.

- Leadership Range: You can lead and grow a team without stepping away from the technical work. This isn’t a role for someone who has moved fully into management.

Our Stack

TapTap Send is an AWS-first, polyglot engineering organisation. Across a small set of major product and platform systems, we use Kotlin/Spring Boot and Python/FastAPI for backend services, React Native/TypeScript for mobile, React/TypeScript for web, PostgreSQL for transactional data, and Redshift + dbt for analytics. You don’t need to have used all of this, but you should be able to get productive in it quickly.

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

title: Principle AI Transformation Consultant
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.
Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.
To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.
BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.
Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.
Location
This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.
Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by BLP.
Your Career Path in AI Transformation Consulting
Our AI Transformation Consulting team has a clear path, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the impact you have had, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

• AI Automation Specialist: Hands-on in the automation itself: you tune agents, run automation sprints and take on your first customers end to end. Typically you bring up to 2 years of experience.

• AI Transformation Consultant: You own a portfolio of live customers as their run lead, including health, growth and account economics. Typically you bring 3+ years in transformation consulting, process improvement or ERP process ownership.

• Principal AI Transformation Consultant: Our most complex and sensitive accounts, at executive level, and you coach the consultants and specialists around you. Typically you bring several years of leading process change at customers.

• Next steps: Lead an AI Transformation Consulting team, or become a Client Partner on our strategic accounts.

Moves into Project Management or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.
Your Mission
For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where our AI Transformation Consulting team sits.
Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organization that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Our job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own.
As a Principal AI Transformation Consultant
You take our most complex and sensitive accounts: large groups with several entities, ERP landscapes and stakeholder levels, where the move to AI-native operations is a real change program and not a configuration task. You lead that change at executive level, with CFOs, heads of shared services and process owners, and you are the person they trust to tell them what has to change on their side for automation to work.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the Role
As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ledgy , you'll build the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably. You'll join our Platform team, collaborating with engineers and InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure for a product that helps companies manage equity.
Our challenge is to make delivery faster, production easier to operate, and AI-assisted development safer - while keeping complexity and costs in check.
Location: We hire remotely across Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania.
The team you'll join: Platform - Builds the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably, working with InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure.
What You'll Work On

•
Cloud infrastructure. Evolve our GCP and Kubernetes cloud architecture and setup with Terraform, improving reliability, simplicity, and cost visibility and enabling scaling to multiple availability regions.

•
CI/CD and developer experience. Speed up feedback loops, reduce flaky builds, and turn recurring support requests into self-service tooling.

•
Observability. Reduce alert noise, define meaningful SLOs, and make production issues easier to diagnose.

•
Security and automation. Partner with InfoSec on secure delivery, access controls, and guardrails for AI-assisted workflows.

You'll also join our incident-response on-call rotation during working hours and help prevent recurring issues. As we expand our servicing of public companies and jurisdictions, this on-call might evolve to compensated 24h/7 hour rotation.
You'll Thrive in This Role If You

• Have worked with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, ideally GCP and Terraform

• Enjoy building fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines and improving developer experience

• Can diagnose issues across networking, infrastructure, and application code

• Write maintainable code and bring a practical approach to observability and security

• Value collaboration, mentorship, and thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, complexity, and cost

• Are curious about supporting AI-assisted development safely - no AI specialism required

Experience with Node.js, MongoDB or Temporal is a plus.
Our Tech Stack
We work in TypeScript: React, Tailwind CSS, and tRPC on the front end, and tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. Infrastructure runs on GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitHub Actions. For observability and incident response we use Grafana, Sentry, and PagerDuty.

title: Senior Support Engineer
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale - unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data - securing and protecting private information more effectively - Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is the role:

We’re always on the search for amazing people. People who have a deep passion for technology and are masters at their craft. We build highly sophisticated distributed systems, and we don’t take our technology lightly. At Elastic, you’ll have the opportunity to work in a vibrant young company next to some of the smartest and highly skilled technologists the industry has to offer. We’re looking for great team players, but we also promote independence and ownership. We’re hackers… The good kind. The kind that innovates and creates cutting edge products that eventually translates to a lot of happy, smiling faces.

Elastic’s Support team is unlike any other on Earth: while we are spread across 12 time zones and 15 countries, we operate as a unit, as a family. We are massively distributed yet lovingly intimate. The service we deliver is caring, empathetic, and human yet ambitious, direct, and comprehensive. We don’t do it alone, as we are tightly integrated with our core developers in a way that is real, genuine, and never taken for granted. Our team is a dream for someone seeking honest, hard work and rewards. It is a nightmare for anyone afraid to ask questions or be questioned - always forward, never backward. We are not trying to change the world, we already have. We’re just waiting for everyone else to catch up. We have our good days and our not so good days, and we face them together, as a family. We listen. We solve. We guide. We get it. And we’re excited to bring on a new team member to love.

 

What You Will Be Doing

• Ensuring technical customer issues are serviced within our contractual SLA and managed to resolution

• Maintain strong relationships with our customers for the delivery of technical support

• Resolves customer problems via telephone, email, chat or remote access.

• Have a mindset of continuous improvement in terms of the efficiency of support processes and customer satisfaction

• Work across multicultural and geographically distributed teams

• Contribute to product documentation, customer knowledge base, and best practices guides

• Continuously improve processes and tools in collaboration with the team

• Provide weekend on-call support for the team rotation (8 hours during regular work hours)

• Develop subject matter expertise one key product feature

• Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. 

• Take part in organizational projects, programs and/or business initiatives using demonstrated creativity and ingenuity to improve performance and customer experience.

• Provide technical leadership in Elastic communities and Knowledge-Centered Service methodology and process.

• Creation of lab environments to replicate customer issues.

• Communicate tactfully with customers: gather information, provide diagnostic and resolution steps, convey process and product guidance

 

What You Bring Along

• 5+ (7+ for C6) years of experience in technical support, system administration or related customer-facing role

• A technical background in systems administration, Network Engineering, Software Engineering, etc

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English

• A customer-oriented focus

• Good understanding of cloud-native and container-based technologies

• Cloud techno
